title: Addition and Subtraction
questionReadAloudEn: What is addition? What is subtraction?
answerReadAloudEn: Addition means putting together two amounts to find the total. Subtraction means taking away or finding the difference.

title: Multiplication
questionReadAloudEn: What is multiplication? What is the multiplication version of five plus five plus five?
answerReadAloudEn: Multiplication means repeated addition of the same number. The multiplication version of five plus five plus five is three times five.

title: Division
questionReadAloudEn: What is division? What symbols show division?
answerReadAloudEn: Division means breaking a total into equal groups. Division can be shown with the division sign, a slash, or a fraction bar.

title: Operation Answers
questionReadAloudEn: What are the following called? Answer to a subtraction problem. Answer to a division problem. Answer to an addition problem. Answer to a multiplication problem.
answerReadAloudEn: The answer to a subtraction problem is the difference. The answer to a division problem is the quotient. The answer to an addition problem is the sum. The answer to a multiplication problem is the product.
